modules.concern: Review acceptance and outstanding review sweep

source_reads.detail: package-wide source snapshot reads recovery.py and produced siblings automatically
LIVENESS_MODULES includes recovery.py and reads its source; extend the scan to moved liveness owners
recursively reads package Python source for size guard; produced siblings enter the scan automatically
recursively reads reckon source and asserts _resolve_commit remains in recovery.py

commands: git grep -n -E '(from reckon\.crew\.recovery import|import reckon\.crew\.recovery|from reckon\.crew import recovery)' -- reckon tests scripts
counting_rule: Every non-import top-level AST statement placed once by starting line. Each estimate includes exact statement bytes, a copy of the original import block, cross-group imports and conservative original reexports; ceil(total bytes / 3.5).
census_method: The receiver-wide setattr search identifies candidates regardless of the fixture variable name. The AST census resolves recovery module aliases and records each static string-valued setattr target by file and call line; a dynamic tuple of target names is recorded separately.
